author: Mishyao
body:
Hello, I am VVVVV14. I was banned from avicus on November 28, 2015 7:03:13 PM GMT for excessive scamming by Awesomerp.
I want to be disbanned because I love this server. I swear never  to scamming. I know that i was stupid to do this but I love this server.

Pls disban me :)

replies.author: Zeusy
replies.body:
Hello,

I've decided to give you the benefit of the doubt and reduce your punishment to a 30 day ban. Thus, please read the rules again (https://avicus.net/rules) and make sure you don't break any rules in the future. 

Best Regards,
Zeusy,
Avicus Senior Moderator
